text_block_list.text:
That night as well, she—the "King of the 
Night"— 
was praying with single-minded devotion.

text_block_list.name: King of the Night
text_block_list.text:
............— 
Forgive me, innocent ones—

Meanwhile, adventurers had arrived at the 
village.

text_block_list.name: Witch
text_block_list.text:
Word is there's some terrible demon lord 
on the loose! 
Heheh, the Great Witch Sweepy 
will just have to take care of them♪

text_block_list.name: Princess
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, and so shall I, a royal princess! 
I shall crush those villains to a pulp 
with my bare fists~~!

text_block_list.name: Village Chief
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, how truly reassuring...! 
Right, you will surely need a guide. 
—Is there anyone willing to accompany 
them?!

I remember what happened before. 
My best friend was snatched away right 
before my eyes, and back then... 
I couldn't do a thing. That's why—

text_block_list.name: Princess
text_block_list.text:
So this is the King of the Night's 
stronghold...! 
It's suddenly pitch black and dreadfully 
damp~~...! 
Where could the kidnapped villagers be?

text_block_list.name: Witch
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, we're dealing with an evil demon 
lord, remember? 
They've probably all been eaten up by now!

text_block_list.name: Princess
text_block_list.text:
Th-That can't be...! 
—Wait, OWCH???!

text_block_list.name: Princess
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? 
What is this? An invisible... wall...?

text_block_list.name: Witch
text_block_list.text:
Heh, now that's some interesting magic! 
But it's nothing I can't handle—heee-yah! 
Open Sesame☆

text_block_list.name: King of the Night
text_block_list.text:
............ 
Who goes there?

text_block_list.name: Princess
text_block_list.text:
—!! You must be the 'King of the Night'... 
We are an itinerant witch and princess— 
and we've come to vanquish you!

text_block_list.name: King of the Night
text_block_list.text:
—— 
......Vanquish me, is it?

text_block_list.name: Witch
text_block_list.text:
What's with that smug, calm look on your 
face~~?! 
I don't like it one bit... Prepare 
yourself!

text_block_list.name: Witch
text_block_list.text:
Fly! Papaya, Mango, Coconut☆ 
——Now Kawakami, hop on!
(*POOOOOOOP!!!!*)

text_block_list.name: Princess
text_block_list.text:
Here it comes, a colossal piece of fruit! 
Time to ride on, away we gooooo~~!!

text_block_list.name: Witch
text_block_list.text:
And—now it's time to attack! 
Burst forth, sweet juice! Tropical 
Splaaash☆
(*SPLAAAAAAASSSSHHHH!!!!*)

text_block_list.name: Princess
text_block_list.text:
And with me added to the mix, Princess 
CRUUUUUUSH!! 
DEIYAAAAAHHHH————————!!

text_block_list.name: Princess
text_block_list.text:
*Pant*, *pant*... Well, how was that?! 
Witness the destructive might of the Witch 
& Princess combo! 
There's no way in hell you're still 
standing—

text_block_list.name: King of the Night
text_block_list.text:
............— 
Impressive coordination—but is that all?
(*——TH-TH-TH-THOOM!!!!*)

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Ngh—!

With a single forceful step from the King 
of the Night, 
a powerful shockwave rippled across the 
room. 
It's all we can do just to stay on our 
feet—!
choice_data_list: (She's too strong...! What do we do?!)

text_block_list.name: Witch
text_block_list.text:
Nnnngh...! Th-That didn't hurt one bit! 
I've still got plenty of energy, this is 
nothi—...hm?

text_block_list.name: Witch
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you... You won't let go of that 
stone, 
even in the middle of a battle. Is there 
some secret to it?

text_block_list.name: Witch
text_block_list.text:
Are you drawing your power from it or 
something...? 
If that's the case—Shatter! Agapanthus☆

text_block_list.name: King of the Night
text_block_list.text:
! 
Stop—
(*—CRACK*)

text_block_list.name: Witch
text_block_list.text:
I don't know why, but 
that really must be the weak spot! 
—Kawakami, focus your attacks while we 
have the chance!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA—————————H!!!
(*SHIIIIIING—*)

text_block_list.name: Princess
text_block_list.text:
Wait—whoa, what is this?! 
It's freezing cold all of a sudden!! 
Brr...!!

text_block_list.name: King of the Night
text_block_list.text: Kh, the 'Queen of Ice'—...

The 'Queen of Ice'—I've heard of her. 
If I recall, she's a demon who dwells in 
the depths of the Netherworld. 
Said to possess power equal to that of the 
King of the Night...

text_block_list.name: Queen of Ice
text_block_list.text:
...Now is not the time for conflict. 
You will understand soon enough— 
on the night of the full moon, three days 
from now.

text_block_list.name: Princess
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey—wait just a moment! 
Hold on... Ugh, this ice is in the way~~!

We'll understand on the night of the full 
moon...? 
Whatever could she mean?—Even as the 
question 
lingered, the two demons had already 
vanished.
